approvedCenter.meaning: Unchanged approved exploration center; not a newly surveyed geographic center or entrance.

distanceMethod.name: Haversine great-circle distance
distanceMethod.formula: a = sin((lat-lat0)/2)^2 + cos(lat0)*cos(lat)*sin((lng-lng0)/2)^2; distanceM = 2*6371000*atan2(sqrt(a),sqrt(1-a)); angles in radians
distanceMethod.rounding: Nearest metre for review arithmetic, not positional accuracy.
distanceMethod.unknownCoordinates: coordinates, distanceFromApprovedCenterM and outside1km are null; never interpret null as zero or inside.
distanceMethod.limitations: Reference-point distance only, not a walking route, verified entrance distance or containment of an entire area. Final review used two manual public Nominatim lookups as documentary leads, followed by direct OSM object checks; no geocoder was installed or integrated, no tiles scanned, and no application code executed.

summary.note: Eight core / two linked retained. Seven core reference pins are sourced. Giang remains unresolved because two mapped nodes claim the same branch/address; no arbitrary point is accepted. The theatre now has an operator-matched mapped-building reference. La Terrasse and the pedestrian-area experience are linked entries, not two extra markers. No new story is publication-approved.
